summary: The source details requirements and flows for a securities back-office processing platform used by a bank. It covers end-to-end workflows across order capture, validation, trading, settlement, reconciliation, amendments, stock transfers, accounting, tax handling, charges/fees, and regulatory reporting. It provides granular rules and state transitions for each process, multi-channel and file-based event handling, manual interventions, regulatory checks, batch and real-time flows, and comprehensive audit/reporting mandates—all under the scope of stringent regulatory/compliance expectations.

workflows.name: Security Product Setup
workflows.description: Setup and mapping of local and foreign securities from external sources (TASE, Bloomberg, Orbis, Magna) reflecting in Bancs with all field validations.
workflows.rationale: 3 sources (TASE, Bloomberg, Orbis) + mapping rules + validation and upload (including error/negative); screens and mapping tables specified.

workflows.name: Security Rate Creation and Maintenance
workflows.description: Upload, validate and maintain security rates from market feeds/providers/manual uploads, with mass and manual entry, validation, and distribution to internal modules.
workflows.rationale: Manual and automated upload and validation, feed failure, mass upload, and downstream rate utilization; UI, file, and error cases.

workflows.name: Order Lifecycle Management
workflows.description: Processing of Buy/Sell/other orders, including validations, placement, blocks, status transitions, partials, and FO/BO handoff.
workflows.rationale: Covers FO/BO, pre/post-trade validation, blocks, state (Authorized, Placed, Executed), amendments/cancellation, multichannel input.

workflows.name: Order Amendment and Correction Flows
workflows.description: Handling post-execution modifications, cancellations, and missing/corrected orders, including 4-eyes approval.
workflows.rationale: UI flows for 3 amendment types + validation + 4-eyes approval and correction handling; detailed screen flows and business gating.

workflows.name: Trade Cycle Processing (Local & Foreign)
workflows.description: End-to-end lifecycle for trade settlement, updates, file ingestion, reconciliation, partials, and error/failure handling for local and foreign trades.
workflows.rationale: Full state transitions, reconciliation via 1051/1054/1052, failure states, FO/BO-driven, batch/manual scenarios, partial execs, file errors.

workflows.name: Manual Matching
workflows.description: Manual reconciliation of unmatched open deliveries and settlement advices, including tolerance rules and error cases.
workflows.rationale: UI grid fields, matching logic, tolerance, errors, search/selection, audit; covers both positive and error/failure.

workflows.name: Stock Transfers
workflows.description: Securities transfer processing for within bank, between banks, and third-party; includes tax rules, validation, batch/real-time orchestration.
workflows.rationale: Different transfer types (within, between, 3rd party, virtual sell), regulatory checks, UI screens, batch, file (15/132), AML/tax handling, statuses.

workflows.name: Cash and Security Movements
workflows.description: Real-time and batch creation/stamping of debit/credit movements, including double-sided booking, backdated/corrected movements, and accounting event integration.
workflows.rationale: Documented calculation rules, accounting-side double-entry, event stamping; covers numeric, correction, and reversal.

workflows.name: Tax Engine Integration
workflows.description: Integration and reconciliation of all security movements with the tax engine, EOD position updates, gap handling, and customer postings.
workflows.rationale: EOD batch, file exchange, tax/refund updates, recon mismatches, correction flows; both positive and negative paths.

workflows.name: Charges, Commissions, and Fee Calculation
workflows.description: Calculation, application, reporting of multi-dimensional fees and commissions as per BOI/TASE/ISA/IRS, with limits, fee types, auditing, and overrides.
workflows.rationale: Multiple fee bases/types (flat, slab, per unit, 3rd party), min/max rules, overrides, aggregation, audit, reporting (414, 814, 815, 425).

workflows.name: Mutual Fund (MF) Trading & Allocation
workflows.description: Order, allocation, clearing, price update/correction, file and manual workflow coverage for MF trading (local and foreign), including auto/manual price correction.
workflows.rationale: Covers workflow matrix: local/foreign, online/offline, auto/manual correction, file and batch, BO/FO, regulatory.

workflows.name: Position Reconciliation
workflows.description: EOD reconciliation and mismatch handling for local securities, foreign securities, and tax engine positions (file 1053, 871, tax engine).
workflows.rationale: Three matrices (local, foreign, tax); recon error and success; BO user report extracts; covers both EOD positive/negative paths.

workflows.name: File Processing and Interface Validation
workflows.description: Ingestion, processing, and error validation for all batch and online files (TASE, Market Info, Broker, APEX), including required technical/business validation and alerts.
workflows.rationale: Multiple file types: 1051, 1052, 1053, 870, 872, 31, 32, 814, 815, 544, including BOD/EOD, technical validation, alerts, retry/failover.

workflows.name: BO Reports and Regulatory Messages
workflows.description: Creation, content, format, and timing of all system-generated BO, regulatory, and end-customer reports, batch/online, UI/export paths.
workflows.rationale: Explicit coverage of all message/report types, file/report generation, user exports, cover EOD, Jasper, regulatory CSV, timing and audit content.

workflows.name: Role and Authorization Flows
workflows.description: Enforcement and validation of FO/BO, 4-eyes, and POA separation of duties, manual control and overrides.
workflows.rationale: 1 for POA/4-eyes on order/amend, 1 for FO/BO/role gating.

workflows.name: UI Screens, Forms, and Field Validation
workflows.description: Validation of key screens (order amendment, stock transfer, manual matching), their search/filter, error, and mandatory field enforcement.
workflows.rationale: Screens for order amendment (3 modes), transfer, manual matching—UI field validation, errors, role interactions.
